title: Unlit drones hovering over 400 ft above Picatinny Arsenal

tellings.quote: These were lights off over 400 feet over Pikatini Arsenal, just sitting there.

plain: In 2024, a helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he once helped retrieve a UFO, tells Michels that he saw drones with their lights off hovering more than 400 feet above Picatinny Arsenal, a military site in New Jersey, "just sitting there". He tells it as something he saw himself, and if true it would mean unknown craft were loitering unlit over a military base.
